notes.text: Both: 16px search icon, 8px from 16px text; placeholder `text-secondary`. On focus the icon turns `qualys-blue`.

Both: 16px text; placeholder `text-secondary`. **No search icon for now:** the placeholder and the field say what it is. `icon` brings back the 16px search icon, 8px from the text, turning `qualys-blue` on focus.

why.text: linen: The profile grid needed its own panel color, #F1F0E9, so it reads as a soft panel and the placeholder avatars still stand out from it.
avatar-container-bg: Names the profile grid's panel color as a token, so it isn't a one-off value.

DrawerCard: Names of different lengths gave mixed layouts (some on one line, some stacked), and equal-width columns left gaps after short names. Profiles now hug their text, all names share one layout, and names are never shortened.
ProfileGrid: The grid sits on its own panel in the new Linen color (avatar-container-bg).
CardModule: Five cards left one card alone on the last row, on the left. Rows now avoid a lone card and center a short last row, like the profile grids.
Stats: On tablet the third stat card sat alone on the left; a lone card is now centered.
Form: Forms needed the banners from the Figma form designs: a photo, a headline on a color, a headline with an image, or a headline over a photo, on any form.
DemoRequestWizard: The same banner options as the forms.
The search icon is removed for now, at the design review's request.
Nav: Search is left out of the nav for now, at the design review's request.
Tabs: Labels sat 10px from the top, with more space below them than above; they're now centered. The autoplay pause button was removed at the design review's request.
TabModule: The autoplay pause button was removed, as in Tabs.
Columns: So every row of cards behaves the same: no card alone on a row, and a short last row centered.
The icon was removed by mistake; only the search in the nav bar was meant to go.
